started
Windows 11 dark palette (face #2B2B2B, border #5A5A5A, accent #4CC2FF, white text) rendered for the button only; every colour is unmeasured (no v3 capture in dark).
2 known gaps
  • No v3 capture exists in dark: all colours are Windows 11 defaults from memory
  • Only the button is rendered in this palette so far
plannedstarted
Five M3 variants (filled, tonal, elevated, outlined, text) in enabled, hovered, focused, pressed, disabled; button_icon.png adds the 18 dp leading icon (16 dp start, 24 dp end, 8 dp gap); fab.png has the small (40, r12), regular (56, r16), large (96, r28) and extended FABs and the four icon buttons (40 dp circle in a 48 dp target). Exact spec values: 40 dp height, full corners, 24 dp side padding, state layers 8/10/10 %, disabled 12 % container / 38 % label, outlined focus outline turns primary, M3 baseline colours, Roboto Medium 14/20 labels. Approximations: elevated shadow, text-button padding with an icon (16 where M3 says 12).
7 known gaps
  • The icon-button toggled forms are approximated (standard primary icon; filled primary; tonal secondary-container; outlined inverse-surface)
  • The elevated button's tonal surface tint at hover (elevation 2) is the 8 % layer only
  • Evidence is the published Material 3 spec geometry from memory, not a capture of a device: nothing here was measured against an Android screenshot
  • Elevation is the Neper shadow (a hard offset, no blur) and no surface tint is drawn; the M3 tonal surface colours stand in for tint
  • No letter spacing: the M3 type scale tracks its text (label-large 0.1 sp, body-medium 0.25 sp, body-large 0.5 sp), the text layout cannot
  • No ripple: pressed is the 10 % state layer only (Android adds a ripple on top)
  • Icons are Neper's stroked glyphs, not Material Symbols (a settings gear, an alert circle and a person differ in drawing)

Basic dialog (surface-container-high, 28 dp corners, 24 dp padding, headline-small, body-medium, two text buttons right aligned, scrim) and dialog_icon.png (icon, centred headline). MaterialLike branch: every dialog action is a text button (M3), not Filled.
7 known gaps
  • Full-screen dialogs, the divider on scroll and the stacked-buttons layout are not on the sheet
  • The dialog's surface tint is not drawn
  • Evidence is the published Material 3 spec geometry from memory, not a capture of a device: nothing here was measured against an Android screenshot
  • Elevation is the Neper shadow (a hard offset, no blur) and no surface tint is drawn; the M3 tonal surface colours stand in for tint
  • No letter spacing: the M3 type scale tracks its text (label-large 0.1 sp, body-medium 0.25 sp, body-large 0.5 sp), the text layout cannot
  • No ripple: pressed is the 10 % state layer only (Android adds a ripple on top)
  • Icons are Neper's stroked glyphs, not Material Symbols (a settings gear, an alert circle and a person differ in drawing)

Gaps: no Neper equivalent yet

  • Embedded browser (TWebBrowser / TEdgeBrowser): No Neper control; listed, not built.
  • Chart (TcxChart / TChart): e.gfx.chart draws charts but there is no chart control with a Windows look.
  • Tray icon (TTrayIcon): No Neper equivalent.
  • Native file dialogs (TOpenDialog / TSaveDialog): No Neper equivalent; the OS dialog is used.
  • Image combo box (TcxImageComboBox): No per-item image in Neper's combo box rows; control.image_select adds it for the Windows look and is the plain select under the others
